what: On phones the recipe walker keeps its two desktop columns, so the code card is 115px wide and every line is cut after about 7 characters ('fmt.Pri', '"strcon'): the program being walked is unreadable.
evidence: Audit at 390: P4 `ol` scrollWidth 380 vs clientWidth 115; the SCREEN card sits beside the code. Crop: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-go-11-15/a15/w390-007-p4.png (also x5.png). Cause: assets/ext/go-ch15.css:36 sets `.walk { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.8fr) minmax(0, 1fr) }` but, unlike go-ch11..14.css, its phone block (@media max-width 600px, :46) never resets it to one column.
fix: Add `.walk { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }` to the phone block at go-ch15.css:46, as ch11-14 do. Before → After (why): `.walk { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1.8fr) minmax(0,1fr) }` at every width → one column below 600px (a 115px code column cannot hold a line of Go).

what: The test-report reader scrolls its box to the wrong place: at steps 1-3 the lit line ('=== RUN TestAdd' and the next two) is above the visible part of the 440px box, so the reader sees an unlit middle of the report while the narration talks about a line they can't see.
evidence: Stepped at 390 (step.js): step 1 lit line top = -84px relative to the box (scrollTop 153), step 2 -80px, step 3 -51px; from step 4 on it is visible. At 1280 the box doesn't scroll, so it's fine. Crop: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-go-11-15/st-390-go_ch15_html-b0-s1.png. Cause: assets/ext/go-ch15.js:57 uses `li.offsetTop`, which is measured from the nearest positioned ancestor (the panel), not from `.rr-wrap`, so it overshoots by the box's own offset.
fix: go-ch15.js:57: compute the offset inside the box: `wrap.scrollTop = Math.max(0, li.getBoundingClientRect().top - wrap.getBoundingClientRect().top + wrap.scrollTop - wrap.clientHeight / 2)` (or give `.report .rr-wrap` `position: relative`). Also run it on reset, not only when `announce` is true.

what: In the report reader long `go test -v` lines wrap back to column 0, so the indentation that shows which subtest a line belongs to is lost ('--- FAIL:' / 'TestAdd/positives (0.00s)', 'Add(-2,' / '-3) = 1, want -5').
evidence: At 390 six `.rr-text` lines wrap to 2 rows each (brk.js), e.g. '    --- FAIL: TestAdd/positives (0.00s)'. Crop: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-go-11-15/st-390-go_ch15_html-b0-s1.png. Cause: go-ch15.css `.report .rr-text { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere }` without a hanging indent.
fix: Call `L.hangLines(ol.querySelectorAll('.rr-text'))` after building the lines (go-ch15.js:43) so wrapped rows continue under their first character. Before → After (why): `.rr-text { overflow-wrap: anywhere }` → engine hanging indent, breaks at spaces only (the indent is the meaning of a test report).

what: The standard-library table is wider than the phone (421px in a 316px box): the 'What's on its shelves' column is cut mid-word at the right edge ('keyboar', 'command-lin', 'ParseFloat' touching the border) with no hint that the table scrolls.
evidence: Audit at 390: `div.std-wrap` scrollWidth 421, clientWidth 316. Crop: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-go-11-15/a15/w390-037-p22.png. Cause: go-ch15.css `.std-table td:first-child { white-space: nowrap }` keeps 'slices, maps, sort' on one line, which sets the first column's width.
fix: Delete `white-space: nowrap` on `.std-table td:first-child` (the package names are separate <code> chips and wrap cleanly), or stack the two cells below 600px. Before → After (why): `td:first-child { white-space: nowrap }` → (removed) (a nowrap column pushes the column people read off screen).

what: The necklace stepper's buttons move on every press: at 1280 the growing SCREEN sits above the controls, so Back/Next slide down 250px over the 13 steps; at 390 they jump by up to 51px between steps.
evidence: step.js button tops at 1280: 6604, 6605, 6605, 6624, 6649 … 6854 (box 1419 → 1670px); at 390: 7638-7689. Emil/DESIGN_SYSTEM: controls must not move under the pointer. Cause: go-ch11.css `.necklace .nk-split { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) }` at every width, so code and screen stack and the screen grows each lap. (The engine-wide narration jump is already in visual-go-6-10.)
fix: At ≥641px lay code and screen side by side (`.necklace .nk-split { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1.6fr) minmax(0,1fr) }`) and give `.necklace .screen pre` a `min-height` for the run's 15 lines (`calc(15 * 1.6em)`), or move `.nk-split` below the controls at every width, as the phone layout already does.

what: The necklace's code list keeps `white-space: pre`, so line 12 (the line that runs each lap) is cut off at 'fmt.Println(i, strin' and its '◀ just ran' marker sits off screen on phones (52px over at 1280 too); the picture's 'byte' label is 9.2px and the byte indexes 11.4px at 390.
evidence: Audit: `ol.tr-code.nk-code` scrollWidth 722 vs 312 at 390, 766 vs 714 at 1280; step.js: 'byte' 9.2px, indexes 11.4px at every step. Crop: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-go-11-15/st-390-go_ch11_html-b0-s3.png.
fix: Drop `.necklace .nk-code li { white-space: pre }` and call `L.hangLines(lis)` in go-ch11.js after filling the list (the engine's hanging indent); in draw() raise the 'byte' label from 17 to 22 units and the index numbers from 21 to 24.

what: Component consistency: the chapter CSS hand-rolls cards, badges and tables with raw values instead of the engine classes and tokens, and repeats the same helper blocks in all five files.
evidence: Hand-rolled cards: `.toolbox` (box-shadow 5px 5px 0, radius 14px), `.beadrow > div`, `.quotes > div` (radius 12px), `.report .rr-wrap` (4px 4px 0, radius 6px); badges: `.stamp` (radius 6px), `.nk-tag`, `.rr-tag`, `.legend li > span:first-child`; tables: `.verbs`, `.fits`, `.std-table` (each re-declares border/padding/header instead of the engine Table styles); `.verbs` also has `border-radius: 10px` with `border-collapse: collapse`, so the radius never shows. Raw fills #F2C9A0, #FFE1E1, #C9F2D9 in go-ch11.css/go-ch14.js. Copied in all five files: `.pic-wide`, `.pair`, `.legend`, `.stamp`, `.verdict-row`, `.swipe-hint`/`.pic-scroll` (which duplicates the engine's `.picscroll`).
fix: Use `.duo-card` for the cards, `.ex-kind`/`.parity`-style badge rules with `--radius-sm`/`--radius-pill`, `--shadow-hard`/`--shadow-hard-lg` and `--radius-md`/`--radius-lg` for the rest, and the engine `.picscroll` instead of the chapter `.pic-scroll`. Before → After (why): `box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 var(--ink)` → `var(--shadow-hard-lg)`; `border-radius: 12px` → `var(--radius-lg)` (one system, one set of numbers).

file: assets/comic.css (.code) — all books; measured in go ch11-15
what: On phones, code blocks cut long lines at a hard edge, often mid-word, with no fade, shadow or 'swipe' hint that the box scrolls: 151 of the code blocks in go ch11-15 hide up to 434px of their lines.
evidence: Audit at 390, `pre.code` blocks that scroll sideways: ch11 28 (max 270px hidden), ch12 41 (323px), ch13 15 (190px), ch14 41 (434px), ch15 26 (384px); at 1280 a further 11. Examples: ch12 P20 'for _, w := range strings.Field|' (contact sheet /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-go-11-15/s12-05.png), ch12 P22 map_slices.go 'append(routes["|'. break-ui failure signature: 'Last row cut off at a hard edge mid-glyph — fixed container with no fade or scroll affordance'. Not in engine-refresh-chapter-todo or the earlier visual reviews (they cover walkers and terminals, not .code).
fix: Either give `.code` the walker's hanging-indent wrap on phones (`L.hangLines` on its lines below 640px, like tracer code and parsons), or add a scroll affordance: `.code { background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--muted) 30%, transparent) left / 24px 100% no-repeat local, linear-gradient(to left, var(--muted) 30%, transparent) right / 24px 100% no-repeat local, radial-gradient(farthest-side at 100% 50%, rgb(0 0 0 / .18), transparent) right / 10px 100% no-repeat scroll, var(--muted) }` (the classic scroll-shadow). Before → After (why): hard-cut `overflow-x: auto` → wrap with hanging indent, or an edge shadow that appears only while more code is hidden (the reader must know there is more).
